title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00132 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:30: L/d BHA on deck. Confirmed all shots fired.
00:30 - 01:10: M/u dummy BHA for testing lubricator. Installed and stabbed lubricator. Leak tested QTS in lubricator to 20/160 bar for 5/10 min
01:10 - 01:45: Closed DHSV and opened HMV. Bled down pressure in tubing from 9 bar to 1 bar.
01:45 - 02:30: Inflow tested DHSV to 8 bar DP for 30 min. Pressure increased 0,27 bar 30 min.
02:30 - 02:40: Held toolbox talk prior to l/d lubricator and GIH to catwalk.
02:40 - 02:55: Closed HMV. Broke lubricator and l/d dummy BHA.
02:55 - 03:35: L/d lubricator and GIH on catwalk using rig-crane and top drive.
03:35 - 03:40: Stabbed on lifting sub to riser section. Unable to latch with drilling elevator due to hydraulic leakage.
03:40 - 04:30: Waited for mechanic to fix hydraulic leakage in drilling elevator. Meanwhile, leak tested KWV to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
04:30 - 04:50: Disconnected lower riser from XMT. Liftet entire riser section and BOP from XMT up to moonpool area.
04:50 - 05:30: Installed top cap on XMT. Tested same to 20/345 bar for 5/10 min.
05:30 - 06:45: Handed well over from intervention to production department. end of operation
